title: The normalized finite compact-support coefficient composition square
statement: Fix a finite-field coefficient datum $B$ of [sk-def-sf-setting], separated finite-type schemes $X,Y,Z$ over its field and separated finite-type maps $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y\to Z$. Choose compactifications $c_f,c_g,c_x$ of $f,g,gf$ and coefficient-compatible constructible exceptional systems $P,Q,R$ of [lem-sf-constructible-exceptional-adjunction-coefficients]. Let $E,L$ be finite coefficient fields, $n,m\ge1$, and let $a:A_{E,n}\to A_{L,m}$ be a coefficient change generated by positive quotients, retained ramified finite extensions, identities and composites with equality of actual ring-sheaf maps. Choose operation data at both levels. Write $F_{h,A}$ and $F_{h,B}$ for the systems' compact-support operations and $\alpha_A,\alpha_B$ for the finiteAlpha compositors [def-sf-finite-exceptional-compositor-maps]. For each vertex choose a scalar presentation $T_U$ identified with actual derived extension along $a$. For $h=f,g,gf$ let $q_h:T_VF_{h,A}\simeq F_{h,B}T_U$ be a coefficient comparison whose realization is the actual proper/open coefficient mate (QNormalized). Then for every finite-Tor constructible $K$ on $X$, $T_Z(\alpha_{A,K});q_{x,K}=q_{g,F_{f,A}K};F_{g,B}(q_{f,K});\alpha_{B,T_XK}$. This is the left-adjoint composition square and asserts no exceptional compositor equation.

proof.text: Fully faithfully include the finite-Tor categories into the ordinary derived ring-module categories. The definitions finiteAlpha and finiteLeft and the field finiteCompositionNormalization identify the lifted composition with the normalized proper/open compositor at every retained etale origin. QNormalized identifies q_h with the canonical proper counit mate followed by open tensor balancing. Apply the quotient or retained finite-free coefficient composition theorem, transport its universal tensor models through Scalar.realization, and cancel the intermediate realization isomorphisms by naturality. For a composite coefficient change paste the two squares using the normalized scalar associators and the left coefficient cocycle; naturality of q_g for the second change interchanges the two central factors. The scalar identity normalization proves the identity case. Reflect the resulting equality through the faithful inclusion. No quotient is assumed flat. This proves q_x C_Z(alpha_A) = alpha_B F_g(q_f) q_g in mathematical composition order.

theorem finiteCompactSupportCoefficientSquare
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} (B : D.CoefficientDatum)
    {X Y Z : SixFunctorSpace D}
    [IsSeparated X.obj.hom] [IsSeparated Y.obj.hom] [IsSeparated Z.obj.hom]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    [IsSeparated f.hom.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f.hom.left] [QuasiCompact f.hom.left]
    [IsSeparated g.hom.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType g.hom.left] [QuasiCompact g.hom.left]
    (P : System.{u} B.l B.Qbar D B.different (f := f.hom.left))
    (Q : System.{u} B.l B.Qbar D B.different (f := g.hom.left))
    (R : System.{u} B.l B.Qbar D B.different (f := (f ≫ g).hom.left))
    (cf : Compactification f.hom.left) (cg : Compactification g.hom.left)
    (cx : Compactification (f ≫ g).hom.left)
    (E L : FieldStage.{u} B.l) (n m : ℕ+)
    (S : SixFunctorOperationDatum D B E.carrier n n.pos)
    (S' : SixFunctorOperationDatum D B L.carrier m m.pos)
    (a : PurCompactSupport.Change ((RingStage.finite E n).coefficients B.l)
      ((RingStage.finite L m).coefficients B.l))
    (_ha : Allowed B.l (s := .finite E n) (t := .finite L m) a)
    (TX : Scalar.{u} B.l B.Qbar a X.obj.left) (TY : Scalar.{u} B.l B.Qbar a Y.obj.left)
    (TZ : Scalar.{u} B.l B.Qbar a Z.obj.left)
    (df : @Comparison.{u} B.l _ B.Qbar _ _ _ X.obj.left Y.obj.left
      (.finite E n) (.finite L m) (P.ring.operation cf (.finite E n))
      (P.ring.operation cf (.finite L m)) TX.functor TY.functor
      TX.commShift TY.commShift)
    (dg : @Comparison.{u} B.l _ B.Qbar _ _ _ Y.obj.left Z.obj.left
      (.finite E n) (.finite L m) (Q.ring.operation cg (.finite E n))
      (Q.ring.operation cg (.finite L m)) TY.functor TZ.functor
      TY.commShift TZ.commShift)
    (dx : @Comparison.{u} B.l _ B.Qbar _ _ _ X.obj.left Z.obj.left
      (.finite E n) (.finite L m) (R.ring.operation cx (.finite E n))
      (R.ring.operation cx (.finite L m)) TX.functor TZ.functor
      TX.commShift TZ.commShift)
    (_hf : QNormalized.{u} B.l B.Qbar cf a TX TY
      (P.ring.left cf (.finite E n)) (P.ring.left cf (.finite L m)) df)
    (_hg : QNormalized.{u} B.l B.Qbar cg a TY TZ
      (Q.ring.left cg (.finite E n)) (Q.ring.left cg (.finite L m)) dg)
    (_hx : QNormalized.{u} B.l B.Qbar cx a TX TZ
      (R.ring.left cx (.finite E n)) (R.ring.left cx (.finite L m)) dx) :
    @LeftCoefficientEquation D B X.obj.left Y.obj.left Z.obj.left
      (.finite E n) (.finite L m)
      (P.ring.operation cf (.finite E n)) (P.ring.operation cf (.finite L m))
      (Q.ring.operation cg (.finite E n)) (Q.ring.operation cg (.finite L m))
      (R.ring.operation cx (.finite E n)) (R.ring.operation cx (.finite L m))
      TX.functor TY.functor TZ.functor
      (Scalar.q B.l B.Qbar TX TY df) (Scalar.q B.l B.Qbar TY TZ dg)
      (Scalar.q B.l B.Qbar TX TZ dx)
      (finiteAlpha B f g P Q R E n S cf cg cx)
      (finiteAlpha B f g P Q R L m S' cf cg cx)
